name: week
title: Vendor risk this week
subtitle: Review dates, unresolved findings and evidence expiry

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select name,owner,criticality,review_due,reason from review_queue order by review_due nulls first

sections.title: Unresolved risk
sections.sql: select vendor,name,risk_score,owner,due_on,waived from finding_position where state='open' order by risk_score desc

sections.title: Concentration
sections.sql: select provider,dependent_vendors,critical_vendors,affected_vendors from concentration order by dependent_vendors desc

sections.title: Rating snapshots
sections.note: Imported ratings are observations from the stated date. This system does not scan vendors.
sections.sql: select name,imported_score,score_observed_on,rating_age_days from vendor_position order by name

name: evidence
title: Evidence and exceptions
subtitle: Read the source before making a decision

sections.title: Evidence validity
sections.sql: select v.name as vendor,e.name,e.reference,e.verified_by,e.verified_on,e.valid_until from evidence e join vendors v on v.id=e.vendor_id order by e.valid_until

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: select v.name as vendor,f.name as finding,w.reason,w.approver,w.expires_on,w.revoked from waivers w join findings f on f.id=w.finding_id join vendors v on v.id=f.vendor_id order by w.expires_on
